name: Omoi Kagami
source:
This is a world dominated by antisoul evil beings. Main character comes to this town to escape from clan rules and live free. But there are terrible things that await him in this town...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个被反灵魂邪恶存在所统治的世界。主角来到这个小镇是为了逃离氏族规则并自由地生活。但这座小镇里还有可怕的事情等待着他……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
